beats.label: New research
beats.text: Scientists tracked blood **proteins** before, during and after **menopause.**
beats.note: Wood Alexander et al., Nature Medicine 2026; UCSB / UCSF news (Nov 2)

beats.label: What shifted
beats.text: **16** proteins rose, tied to **inflammation** and **brain** aging.

beats.label: Not just age
beats.text: The changes tracked menopause **stage** more than **birthdays.**

beats.label: Years later
beats.text: In nearly **12,000** older women, higher levels went with **poorer** memory and thinking.

beats.label: The risk
beats.text: Plus a **modestly** higher Alzheimer's risk over about **16** years.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: A **link,** not a cause. Most women **never** get Alzheimer's, and there's **no** test yet.
Follow so you hear about **midlife** research **first.**
